title: Star Maps

beats.narrativeText: A damaged observatory contains unfinished astronomical observations.
Star charts and positional clues hint at what the expedition had been tracking.
The learner matches constellations and reads the station's star maps.
beats.trigger: Constellations matched and star maps read

beats.narrativeText: Measuring angles between recorded positions begins to reveal a pattern in the sky.
The learner must interpret the observations to reconstruct what the expedition was studying.
The reconstructed observations reveal the expedition's wider scientific objectives.
The learner reflects on how much can be learned from carefully recorded, unfinished data.
The observatory becomes operational again, hinting that the expedition's research extended far beyond the station itself.

activities.title: Match Constellations
activities.storyContext: A damaged observatory contains unfinished astronomical observations.
activities.instructions: Match the recorded star patterns to known constellations.

activities.title: Read Star Maps
activities.storyContext: Star charts and positional clues hint at what the expedition had been tracking.
activities.instructions: Read the station's star maps and note the positions the expedition recorded.
activities.output: Notes on the recorded star positions.

activities.title: Measure Angles
activities.storyContext: The positions recorded by the expedition may form a pattern in the sky.
activities.instructions: Measure the angles between the recorded star positions.
activities.output: A set of measured angles between recorded positions.

activities.title: Interpret Observations
activities.storyContext: Reconstructing the observations may reveal what the expedition was studying.
activities.instructions: Interpret the matched constellations and measured angles to reconstruct the expedition's observations.
activities.output: A reconstructed set of astronomical observations.

activities.title: Create a Seasonal Star Guide
activities.storyContext: A seasonal star guide would help future Explorers use the observatory.
activities.instructions: Create a simple seasonal star guide showing constellations visible at different times of year.

activities.title: Navigating by the Night Sky
activities.storyContext: Long before modern instruments, explorers relied on the stars to find their way.
activities.instructions: Find out how explorers navigated using the night sky before modern technology.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: What do you think the expedition was studying with the observatory?

discussionPoints: What do you think the expedition was tracking in the night sky?
How did measuring angles help you interpret the observations?
parentGuide.preparation: No special preparation required; a real star map or night sky app can enrich the experience if available.
parentGuide.assessment: Look for careful matching of constellations and observations interpreted with reasoning, not guesswork.

completionCriteria: Constellations matched, star maps read, angles measured, and observations interpreted.
